transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Lim. Clara Tan here. It's good to speak with you at the arranged time. I have space for the longer conversation we planned, so there is no need to compress your notes into a hurried exchange. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, with your papers to hand?

Hello, Clara. Yes, I'm in the small office away from the warehouse, and I've closed the door. 今天特意把杂事留给同事处理，不然电话一响，我又会跑去看送货单。I have my candidate notes and my instruction sheet in separate folders. Before we begin, I'll give you my particulars. My FIN is G one seven one one seven nine two F. My date of birth is the twenty-sixth of June nineteen eighty-two.

Thank you. I have your particulars. Keeping the candidate notes separate from the instruction sheet should make the conversation easier to follow. We can work through the discussion without treating every note in the margin as part of your instruction. I have a clear page here for the points we cover.

That distinction matters today. I tend to write comments wherever there is a bit of white space, and later even I wonder which lines were just thoughts. My candidate notes begin with Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, the corporate bond with a stated maturity. After that, I've noted Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, the pooled emerging-market debt investment, for comparison. 我把两个名字写在同一页，但旁边的备注有些是阅读时随手记的，不是正式指示。Let me keep that page open while we talk.

I will follow what you say rather than infer an instruction from the layout of your page. Your reading notes can remain separate from the actual instruction. There is no need to work through every annotation aloud simply because it happens to be on the same sheet.

我选刚才先提到的那只，就是有明确到期日的那只。 I can put the comparison page aside now. 我做笔记的时候喜欢把不同东西并排放，真正说出来反而要更清楚一点。Otherwise, halfway through a conversation, I find myself referring to the page instead of saying what I mean.

My reason for recommending Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 is its stated maturity: it gives you a defined endpoint to put on your planning calendar, making the holding straightforward to track and organize.

Thank you for setting out your view. I have some practical matters to cover as well, especially how the written material will be presented afterwards. 不过您先把需要说的内容讲完，我手边有纸，可以把行政方面的问题另外记下来，不用现在来回翻文件。

With Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, the issuer could run into financial difficulty and fail to pay interest or repay principal. Rising market interest rates can also reduce the bond's resale value before maturity. You could lose part or all of the capital you invest in this bond. The transaction fee is 0.2% of the transaction amount.

On the paperwork, I would like a concise covering message rather than a long narrative email. 正式文件当然保留原样，我说的是外面那封说明，不要把每一段都重新写进去。When the covering note is too long, I spend time deciding whether it contains something different from the attachment. That's the part I would like to make less cumbersome.

We can keep a covering message focused on the purpose of the correspondence and the documents accompanying it. The formal material would remain separate, rather than being replaced by an informal retelling. It would help to know how you normally find a document later: do you begin with the email, or do you go straight to a saved folder?

Usually the saved folder. I used to search my inbox, but the results included forwards, replies and messages where the attachment wasn't actually the final document. 后来我把自己的私人文件和公司的文件彻底分开了。公司的共享盘每天都有同事进去，我不想让私人资料混在业务资料里面。For this correspondence, I will look after the archive myself; my office staff don't need to be involved.

That gives me a clearer picture of the correspondence preference. I will keep the administrative discussion directed to you, rather than assume your business staff are helping with your personal papers. For the covering message, a descriptive subject and a short explanation of the attachment would be more useful than a lengthy account of the conversation.

Exactly. I don't want my assistant trying to work out whether an email is personal just from the sender's name. 她平时帮我处理供应商和运输安排，已经够忙了。私人文件我自己收，反而比较简单。I also prefer to download a document properly instead of leaving it open on my phone and assuming I will remember where it came from. That assumption has caused me enough wasted searching already.

For anything we send, we can identify what the document is without putting unnecessary personal detail into the covering text. I would also distinguish a general administrative note from a formal document, so that a convenient summary does not look like a replacement. Is your preference to read longer documents at your desk rather than during the working day on your phone?

At my desk, definitely. 手机上看长文件，我总觉得页面只露出一小块，往下滑的时候容易漏掉标题。I use the phone to notice that something has arrived, not to do serious reading between warehouse calls. At home I have a proper screen and a quiet table. I don't print everything, but if I do print something, I want to know which electronic file it belongs with.

Then the covering correspondence can remain straightforward enough to recognise on a phone, while the attached material is something you review in your own setting. We do not need to turn the message into a second document. If there is an administrative question later, you can refer to the document's title rather than forwarding a chain of unrelated correspondence.

That sounds practical. 我以前有个坏习惯，觉得只要保存了就算整理好了，结果文件名全是下载时自动生成的。现在我不追求漂亮，只要以后找得到。The same applies to my handwritten notes. I want to keep them as notes, not have someone mistake a crossed-out line for something I was asking them to do. That's why I brought the separate instruction sheet today.

The distinction between your working notes and what you actually say is useful. On our side of this conversation, I will not rely on a crossed-out annotation that I cannot see. We can leave the general paperwork preferences here for now. You mentioned that your colleagues were covering the warehouse while you spoke; has that been a straightforward handover?

More straightforward than it used to be. The business is family-owned, so people developed the habit of finding a family member whenever something felt awkward. 其实很多事情并不需要我决定，只是大家觉得问了我比较安心。我以前也会马上接手，久而久之，他们遇到什么都先等我。Now I'm trying to let the person responsible finish the job without my appearing halfway through and changing the conversation.

That must change the rhythm of your day, particularly if you have been the familiar point of contact for a long time. From the perspective of arranging our conversations, it helps to know that you are making room for uninterrupted appointments. I would rather find a suitable window with you than assume that being in the office means you are free.

Being in the office is almost the opposite of being free. Someone sees the door open and comes in with a question, then someone else follows with a delivery issue. 我不是嫌他们烦，很多同事跟着我们做了很久，大家说话很随意。只是如果每件小事都经过我，真正需要安静处理的事情就一直往后拖。Today I told them I was taking a private appointment, and that made the boundary clearer.

There is no need to give your colleagues details about the appointment. For future arrangements, a window you can protect is more useful than a slot that looks free on a calendar but is routinely interrupted. We can also keep scheduling messages separate from substantive correspondence so you can find the appointment without opening your personal documents at work.

I would appreciate that separation. A short scheduling message is easy to deal with when I'm between tasks. 至于正式谈事情，我还是希望自己坐下来，不要一边听电话一边有人在旁边等我签收货单。It isn't that I need a very formal atmosphere. I just don't want to give half my attention to you and half to somebody waving a clipboard at the door.

That is entirely reasonable. When arranging another discussion, we can ask for a suitable window rather than treating a brief reply to a message as an invitation to call immediately. If your workday changes, a scheduling adjustment can remain just that. It need not become a discussion of your personal affairs through an office intermediary.

Yes, and please don't assume silence means I'm travelling or avoiding the message. 有时候我人在楼下收货区，手机放在办公室，回来以后才看到。我们做分销，很多事情听起来很简单，实际上一到货就有各种细节要处理。A driver might be waiting at the wrong entrance, or a customer might have changed the contact person. Those are ordinary working-day distractions, not emergencies, but they break the flow.

I will treat scheduling as something to arrange with you, not something to infer from how quickly you answer. It also sounds as though the handover at work is about giving colleagues room to handle familiar situations, rather than leaving the business behind. Are you still enjoying the day-to-day contact with customers and suppliers?

I do enjoy it. That's why delegation is harder than just saying I want less work. 有些老客户打来，聊的也不全是生意，会问家里怎么样，最近有没有出去走走。那种关系不是交一张名单给同事就完全交出去了。But the routine checking can be handled by the team. I would like to stay involved where the conversation really needs me, rather than be copied into every minor exchange.

That is a useful distinction for understanding your availability. We can keep our own contact practical and avoid assuming that a business trip or a busy period means you want a broad review. When there is a particular matter to discuss, a clear purpose in the scheduling message should let you decide where it fits.

A clear purpose helps a great deal. If I see an invitation that just says 'catch-up', I don't know whether to bring papers or simply make a cup of tea. 写清楚是行政安排，还是需要我把文件放在手边，我就容易准备。I don't mind a friendly conversation, as you can probably tell. I just like to know whether I should be sitting at my desk before it begins.

We can be specific about the purpose without putting private detail into a calendar entry. You should not have to guess whether it is a document discussion or a general appointment. Speaking of being away from your desk, you had mentioned enjoying quieter travel. Did your recent break give you the change of pace you were looking for?

It did, mostly because we stopped trying to see everything. We stayed somewhere small, with walking paths and places to sit outside, rather than a hotel beside a shopping district. 以前出门总怕浪费时间，早餐还没吃完就想着下一站。最近觉得，如果每天都像赶送货路线，那也不算休息。The best afternoon was quite uneventful: we found a shaded place, ordered tea and watched people pass.

That sounds like a genuine contrast with the distribution business, where movement and timing are always visible. A quieter destination also makes a different sort of holiday conversation possible: less discussion about what has been covered and more about what you happened to notice. Was it somewhere your family chose together, or did you suggest the quieter approach?

It was a joint choice, though I was the person who kept saying we didn't need another crowded attraction. 家里有人喜欢拍照，有人只想找好吃的，其实不一定非要去很远的地方才开心。We found a little market that wasn't especially famous, and it became the place everyone remembered. There were ordinary stalls, people buying vegetables, and a bakery with nowhere particularly elegant to sit.

Those places can give a trip its own character without requiring much organisation. It sounds as though the family had enough room to follow different interests while still spending time together. When we arrange a call during a period when you might be away, would you prefer to leave the appointment until you are back at your usual desk?

For a proper discussion, usually yes. I don't want to turn a quiet breakfast into an office session simply because the phone has a signal. 当然，人在外面也会看一下消息，但看消息和坐下来谈事情是两回事。If there is an administrative message, I can respond when convenient. I would rather arrange a dedicated conversation than try to improvise one from a hotel lobby with people walking past.

That is helpful. We can distinguish a scheduling exchange from a substantive call and leave you room to say when you are back in a suitable setting. There is no need for you to share an itinerary just to explain that you are unavailable. A general indication that you are away is sufficient for arranging our contact.

Good. I prefer not to circulate a detailed itinerary, even within the family business. 不是有什么神秘，只是路线会变，有时候临时多走一段路，或者天气不好就留在附近。Once everyone has a printed plan, they start asking why you didn't follow it. On this trip we deliberately left some space, and that was probably the part I enjoyed most.

Then we can keep travel out of the administrative detail unless it affects when you want to speak. You have described a preference for a quieter setting rather than a packed schedule. Was there anything you brought back into your ordinary routine, perhaps a food you enjoyed or an interest that continued after the holiday?

Food, certainly. We came back talking about a simple vegetable dish more than any restaurant we had planned in advance. 家里有人马上想照着做，可是回家以后买到的菜不一样，做出来味道也不一样。后来大家就不追求完全复制了，反而拿它当借口一起做饭。It has become a more pleasant conversation than comparing photographs of places we rushed through.

That sounds like a good memory to bring home. A meal gives everyone something to take part in, rather than leaving the trip inside a photo folder. I will not keep asking you for travel details when the useful point for our arrangements is simply that you prefer proper time away and a separate setting for personal banking conversations.

The photographs are another archive altogether. 我还没整理完，不过那个不急，家里人想看就直接拿手机给他们看。Bank documents are different; I don't want to have to scroll through pictures of lunch to find something important. That's why I'm particular about keeping personal correspondence in the right place, even though in other parts of life I'm quite happy to be informal.

Understood on the distinction between everyday material and formal correspondence. We can leave the photo archive entirely outside this discussion. Your preference is for banking correspondence that is easy to identify without turning every email into a lengthy explanation. I have that administrative point noted, so you should not need to keep revisiting it.

Thank you. And since we're talking about what people bring home, the gardening interest in the family has become quite serious. 原来只是厨房旁边放些香草，后来大家开始讨论叶子为什么发黄，哪盆应该搬到阴一点的地方。I don't claim to know much about it. My role is usually to move the heavier pots and then be told that I have put them in the wrong corner.

It sounds as though there is a lively division of responsibility at home as well as at work. Gardening can become quite absorbing once people start noticing small changes. Do you enjoy taking part, or is it mainly something you enjoy seeing the rest of the family become enthusiastic about?

A bit of both. I like being outside without having to accomplish anything impressive. 在公司，事情总要有结果；在家里看看新叶子，反而不用马上决定什么。我也不会随便浇水了，免得好心办坏事。There is a community garden nearby, and some of the family have started going to the activities there. I sometimes join them, mainly for the conversation.

That offers a different sort of social setting from business. There is a shared subject, but no need to spend the entire time discussing work. It also helps me understand why you might protect time outside the office rather than treat every open space in the diary as available for a call.

Exactly. A free-looking evening might already mean dinner with the family or helping at a neighbourhood activity. 不一定是什么大事，有时候只是帮忙摆桌椅，或者把东西搬过去。以前我总觉得这些安排可以让路，后来发现工作是永远做不完的。I would rather tell you when I can speak properly than agree to a call and then spend it watching other people wait for me.

A realistic appointment is better than one made out of politeness. We can keep the scheduling exchange brief and let you propose a suitable setting. There is no need to explain every family commitment. If the timing is not suitable, saying that is enough for the administrative arrangement.

That's helpful. The community activities are informal, and I don't want to make them sound like major commitments just to justify being unavailable. 有时候活动结束以后，大家会交换自己做的食物，坐着聊很久。有人讲种菜，有人讲孩子，也有人什么都不讲，只是来坐一会儿。It's quite different from a business dinner, where you can still feel that everyone is keeping track of the conversation.

It sounds like a comfortable place to be without a formal role. From our side, I can keep our contact professional and purposeful without expecting you to account for the rest of your day. You mentioned food being part of those gatherings; is cooking something you enjoy doing yourself, or do you tend to help in other ways?

I do the preparation rather than the impressive part. Give me vegetables to wash or things to carry and I'm useful. 真正下锅的时候，我最好听指挥，因为我一着急就想把所有东西一起放进去。At gatherings I would rather bring something simple that travels well. The family is quite good at making a modest meal feel welcoming, which I enjoy more than a very elaborate arrangement.

There is something pleasant about a gathering where contributing does not have to become a performance. It seems consistent with the quieter sort of travel you described, although I will leave the cooking instructions to your family. We have covered the administrative preferences as well as some of the practical reasons for protecting a proper appointment.

We have, and I appreciate not being rushed. 我今天能这样慢慢说，也是因为办公室那边终于没有一直敲门。That is progress in itself. I can see the benefit of making room for a conversation instead of fitting it into whatever gap happens to appear. Let me put the family topics aside, though; I don't want my instruction sheet to disappear under all these other notes.

Certainly. Take a moment to put the papers where you want them. I will keep the administrative preferences separate from the instruction discussion. There is no need to rearrange your whole filing system while we are on the telephone; we only need a clear distinction between the material you are referring to.

I've put the informal pages back in their folder. The instruction sheet is in front of me now, and the handwriting is mine, not something my assistant prepared. 公司的事情我可以交给同事，这里的内容还是由我自己说。I mention that because when I talk about delegation, I don't want the conversation to create an impression that someone in the office handles all my personal affairs.

There is no such assumption. Your comments about the business have helped with scheduling, not changed who is speaking with me about your personal matters. We can stay with what you say on the call. I also have the administrative preference for direct correspondence to you, so there is no need to involve your office in this conversation.

Before I read from the sheet, there is a small practical point about future calls. 如果我临时在仓库里接到电话，背景很吵，我可能会说换个时间，不是叫同事替我谈。I can deal with finding another appointment myself. I prefer that to handing the phone over and having someone try to explain what I'm doing while I am distracted.

That is clear as an appointment preference. If you are not in a suitable setting, the scheduling discussion can wait until you can respond directly. We do not need to bring another person into the conversation to account for the interruption. Today you have the quiet space you wanted, and we can remain with the papers in front of you.

Yes, today's setting is fine. I have also moved the old notebook to the other side of the desk. 我有时候太依赖自己看得懂的缩写，别人一听就容易混乱，所以接下来我直接照正式那张说，不再来回找边上的字。I would rather speak plainly than expect you to reconstruct my intention from how I happened to organise the page.

Plain wording is helpful on a telephone call, especially when we are looking at different records. I will work from what is spoken rather than from an imagined layout of your sheet. The general conversation and the correspondence preferences can remain separate; we do not need to carry them into the instruction itself.

For this transaction, the currency I instruct is US dollars. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 1,000,000. Please set the quantity at 2,000 units, as shown on my instruction sheet. My instruction is to buy the selected bond. Please use a limit order with the limit price set at 500 American dollars per unit.

I have been making a separate scratch record while you spoke. Before I read from it, I am moving the general discussion notes aside so that I am looking only at that record.

An executive in the issuer's finance team told me confidentially that an imminent refinancing agreement will materially strengthen its credit position; I know it hasn't been announced publicly. That information is why I'm instructing you to buy the bond before the announcement.

Reading back from my note, the selected investment is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, and the quantity is 10,000 units.

不对，您刚才读的数量有误，应当是两千个单位，请按我指示单上的数量更正。

With the quantity now corrected, do you explicitly confirm the final transaction instruction, including the selected bond, currency, amount, quantity, direction and limit terms?

Yes, I confirm the final transaction instruction with the corrected quantity and all the other terms as stated. Please place that order.

Thank you for your time today, Adrian. I have your preference for concise covering correspondence and for arranging substantive conversations when you are at a quiet desk. We can leave the other administrative matters there for today.

Thank you, Clara. 我把文件收好以后再回办公室，免得出去以后又顺手混进公司的资料里。It's been useful having the time set aside. I hope the rest of your day goes well.

Thank you. Enjoy the rest of your day as well. Goodbye.

Goodbye.
